domain-information: A Service Manager analyzes usage data and informs the fleet coordinator to meet peak demand
A Service Manager sets pricing strategies that affect the price for bookings
A Fleet Coordinator monitors vehicle locations and schedules cars for cleaning and refueling to maintain readiness
A Fleet Coordinator plans fleet expansion and reallocates vehicles across city zones based on demand trends
A Customer Support Agent assists users with booking issues and answers questions about vehicle policies
A Customer Support Agent processes damage reports and communicates with users to resolve disputes
A User searches for available cars nearby and books a vehicle for a short-term trip
A User reports vehicle issues or updates their profile to ensure smooth future rentals
A User leaves feedback on their ride experience and suggests improvements to the platform
